video_title: Gilbert Arenas gets opens up on he RUINED his ENTIRE career because he was ignorant 👀

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his lack of understanding regarding serious knee injuries
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know like how serious a knee injury was

text_blocks.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
text_blocks.text: I didn't know like how serious a knee injury was. I broke my hand, cut the cast off, let's go play. I can use the other one. Knee hurt? I can just jump off the other one, not realizing it's stop-go.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: Tell us about your out the mud experience with coming and messing with that knee injury, man. Talk to me about it.

quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas admits he did not understand the severity of knee injuries during his career saying I did not know how serious a knee injury was. I thought I could just jump off the other one.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his rushed recovery process after knee injury
quotes.excerpt: they're telling me, 'Yo, you got to be out six, eight months.' Two months, I'm like, 'Nigga, I'm ready.'
quotes.quote: They're telling me, 'Yo, you got to be out six, eight months.' Two months, I'm like, 'Nigga, I'm ready. When the season starts, let's go.' So I'm still doing the stairs, I'm doing everything, and then realize that I'm not—you ain't rehabbing right. You're not sleeping right, you're not eating right, you're not rehabbing, you're not doing all the little things. This shit boring. Let's get to the hooping, let's play these ones. I need to get back, I'm a three-time All-Star, I got to make this fourth one.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas reflects on his rushed recovery process after knee surgery saying I was not rehabbing right because this shit boring. I just wanted to get back to hooping.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on ignoring the rehabilitation process for his knee
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't serious about that part of the process.
quotes.quote: I wasn't serious about that part of the process. Those were the RDLs, the band work, backs were walking. I love that type of shit. I didn't understand the process.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas admits he struggled with the discipline required for rehab during his playing days saying I was not serious about that part of the process. I did not understand it.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas questioning the necessity of specific knee rehabilitation exercises
quotes.excerpt: Why in the hell am I doing the TKE knee stretch?
quotes.quote: I used to ask them questions, 'Why in the hell am I doing the TKE knee stretch?' They're like, 'This is going to fire your quad, you got to have all these things firing.' So why am I doing it? I'm asking these questions just as much as you ask questions on the court, but I'm like, 'Man, I need to know this about my body.'
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas on his mindset during rehab sessions saying I used to ask them why in the hell am I doing the TKE knee stretch. I needed to know how my body worked.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his decision to skip a workout for the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: Memphis looking for a guard... Can you go workout? I talked myself out of it.
quotes.quote: Memphis looking for a guard, any backup guard, veteran guard, that, you know, just in case something happened in the playoffs. Can you go workout? I talked myself out of it. I was like, 'Ah man, you don't need a nigga like me, man. You need somebody in shape. I'm still going to need about 30 days.' I just got my money, so I don't want to work for it. I'm getting it for free, so I don't want to work for the second one.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas reveals he talked himself out of a workout with the Memphis Grizzlies because he did not want to put in the work saying I just got my money so I did not want to work for the second one.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his eventual decision to sign with the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I made the team. So I ain't coming back.
quotes.quote: Memphis is looking for a guard. I made the team. So I ain't coming back. Click. Go to Portland, had to go to the mall, met you guys, and then that was that.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas recalls his brief stint with the Memphis Grizzlies before deciding to move on.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on managing bone spurs and pain during his career
quotes.excerpt: I had to sleep in that. See, I never really was going up and down
quotes.quote: End up having bone spurs started creeping in. So at night I had to wear the high-rise sleeve. I had to sleep in that. See, I never really was going up and down so I never really felt the pain like that. So once I started playing, it was just throbbing. I had to sleep with like so every 90 minutes I had to just push on, so that cool air kind of like stop it from throbbing. I was struggling that year.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas describes the physical toll of bone spurs during his career saying I had to sleep with a high rise sleeve and every 90 minutes I had to push on it to stop the throbbing.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on the reasons behind his retirement
quotes.excerpt: The reason I retired is because Josh Shelby... and Genaro... Jeremy.
quotes.quote: The reason I retired is because Josh Shelby... and Genaro... Jeremy. Because I was across the street, they'll call me, 'Hey, can you workout with us, show us this, show us that?' And you know, you got little fiery motherfuckers like, 'Let's play the ones, let's play the ones.' Book my ass in the ones, boy. They was telling, they was telling my ass to play the ones. But just, you know how you see I seen the rookie and sophomore year me. Seeing the passion, right? They ready. I mean that motherfucker like, 'Ah shit, coach, hey, Gill, son.' You see them niggas like, 'Ah man.'
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas on the moment he realized he should retire saying I saw the rookie and sophomore year me in these young guys and realized I do not have it here no more.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his realization that he no longer had it
quotes.excerpt: I don't have it here no more. As long as I want a team for the price, they're going to always pick me up.
quotes.quote: I don't have it here no more. As long as I want a team for the price, they're going to always pick me up. If I'm a veteran man, they're like, 'Shit, if he come out, give us 10, 8, that's better than, you know, playing one of the young.' And I'm like, 'Man, as long as I want a team, they're going to keep, they're going to keep shelving them.' I'm going to go ahead, let's young fellas, y'all have this man. I already, I already lived it, I did it, man. I fucked it off. I still got the money, so I'm going to let y'all live this dream, man, while y'all still like got it in y'all.
quotes.social_post: Gilbert Arenas on his decision to walk away from the NBA saying I already lived it and I did it. I am going to let the young fellas have this dream while they still got it.
